description: I'm an outspoken public speaker, 5-year school MC team member, and theater performer, connecting with people comes naturally to me. My passion for astronomy began in 6th grade through an NSS project—originally started just to support a close friend. Over four years of dedicated teamwork, that act of friendship ignited an incredible, unexpected love for space science. Today, I am combining my voice and love for astronomy to bridge the gap between play and real science.
summary:
Astro Life is an immersive, STEM-infused gaming simulation set in a lunar outpost. We developed a narrative-driven game following a 16-year-old resident named Dorothy, where players resolve time-sensitive crises like micro-meteorite leaks and life-support fluctuations while piloting lunar rovers for sample collection.

The project addresses the EdTech challenge of educational tools being either too superficial or overwhelmingly technical by striking a balance between real science and engaging gameplay. Players apply genuine scientific and engineering solutions—such as closed-loop recycling and radiation shielding—through a rewarding upgrade and survival cycle.

This project is important because it transforms complex aerospace concepts into an interactive, emotionally resonant experience. By gamifying critical thinking and practical problem-solving, it fosters a deeper, lasting connection to STEM for students.
details: Astro Life is an immersive, STEM-infused gaming simulation designed to make space science genuinely exciting and approachable for students. Set in a lunar outpost through the eyes of a 16-year-old resident named Dorothy, the game strikes a perfect balance—avoiding overly dry technical jargon while steering clear of superficial science that lacks real educational value. Players dive into hands-on problem-solving by managing life-support systems, upgrading base defenses against solar flares and moon dust, and piloting rovers across hazardous lunar craters to collect samples. By gamifying realistic aerospace challenges like power grid management and closed-loop recycling into a rewarding upgrade cycle, Astro Life turns complex survival mechanics into an engaging, emotionally resonant learning experience.
